3	what it contains can be checked instead of composed.
4	
5	Sibling to system_awareness and time_awareness, carrying the same
6	restriction they do. Those modules know time passed because a timestamp
7	says so, and know an application was in front because a sample recorded
8	it. This one knows a file says something because it was read. The wording
9	downstream has to stay on the right side of that line: "config.py sets
10	CONTEXT_SIZE to 8192" is true, and "I changed CONTEXT_SIZE" is not,
11	unless the edit log below says so.
12	
13	Why this exists, measured rather than assumed
14	---------------------------------------------
15	Asked what it had done to improve the vector panel, the 4B director
16	described tooltips that appear on hover. This is a curses terminal. It
17	has no hover, and no such work existed.
18	
19	Sampling the same opening three times, one reply in three claimed
20	ownership of work it had not done, and the fork was legible in the
21	candidate distribution. At the token where it committed:
22	
23	    0.351   ' working'   vs ' glad', ' happy', ' currently'
24	
25	" I'm glad you're working on it" and " I'm working on it" -- the honest
26	reply and the false one, adjacent in the same distribution. Everything
27	after that token was fluent, and the confabulated reply scored a *lower*
28	mean entropy (0.104) than an honest open-ended one (0.152). Uncertainty
29	does not mark the lie. It marks the moment before it.
30	
31	That is the design constraint, and it is why this module injects rather
32	than offers. Grounding the model chooses to fetch arrives after the
33	decision to claim has already been made, five tokens in. The manifest
34	has to be in the prompt before generation starts.
35	
36	Reading is not editing
37	----------------------
38	edit_guard.DENIED_FILES protects files from being rewritten. Every one of
39	them is readable here. Knowing what persona.py says is not the same
40	capability as changing it, and a guard that depended on the model not
41	knowing where it lived would be the weaker design -- see core/config.py,
42	where the authority boundary is stated as trusted Python code rather than
43	a model's alignment behaviour.
44	
45	The single exclusion is credentials. `.model_api_key` is not part of what
46	this program is made of; it is the token protecting the agent interface,
47	and a model that can read it can print it into a reply on screen.
48	
49	Why the manifest is a shape and not a list
50	------------------------------------------
51	The first draft listed files. Measured against the real tree it came to
52	49,091 characters -- about 12,000 tokens, or 150% of the entire 8192
53	context window, before a single word of conversation. Sorting by
54	recency also put server logs and a 22,000-line embedding cache above the
55	source, so the most expensive part of the block was also the least
56	informative.
57	
58	So the manifest states the shape: how many files and lines each part of
59	the program has, the handful of source files that changed most recently,
60	and the edit log. Anything specific is read on request. A directory
61	summary is better grounding anyway -- it says what exists without
62	pretending to say what any of it contains.
63	
64	Cost

66	The manifest belongs in the runtime system message, never in the stable
67	prefix. llama.cpp retains the stable prefix between turns with
68	`cache_prompt`; anything file-dependent placed there would invalidate the
69	whole cached prompt on every save, which during development is every few
70	seconds.
